MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 14

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 55
   C. 32
   D. 22

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 30
   C. 40
   D. 75

6. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 32

7. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 37
   C. 36
   D. 13

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

9. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 11

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 90

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 10

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

15. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 40

17. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

18. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

19. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

20. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

21. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

22. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

23. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 8

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
